endpoint.description: Base URL of the Stalwart server, e.g. `https://mail.example.com`. The provider appends the `/jmap` management endpoint. May also be set with the `STALWART_ENDPOINT` environment variable.

password.description: Password for HTTP Basic authentication (used with `username`). May also be set with the `STALWART_PASSWORD` environment variable.

token.description: Bearer token used for authentication. Takes precedence over `username`/`password`. May also be set with the `STALWART_TOKEN` environment variable.

username.description: Username for HTTP Basic authentication (alternative to `token`). May also be set with the `STALWART_USERNAME` environment variable.

block.description: Manage a Stalwart mail and collaboration server (v0.16+) through its JMAP management API.

domain.description: Name of the domain this object belongs to, e.g. `example.com`. Resolved to a domain id at apply time. Mutually exclusive with `domain_id`.

domain_id.description: Opaque id of the domain this object belongs to. Mutually exclusive with `domain`.

email_address.description: Full email address of the account, formed as `name@domain` (server-set).

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the account.

member_of.description: Ids of groups this account is a member of (maps to `memberGroupIds`).

name.description: Account name — the local part of the email address (the part before `@`). Changing it replaces the account.

password.description: Password credential for the account. Write-only: the server never returns it, so it is not refreshed into state and out-of-band changes are not detected.

quota.description: Maximum disk space allocated to the account, in bytes (maps to the `maxDiskQuota` storage quota). Omit or set to 0 for unlimited.

role.description: Built-in role for the account: `User`, `Admin`, or `Custom`. Defaults to `User`.

role_ids.description: Custom role ids assigned to the account, used when `role` is `Custom`.

used_disk_quota.description: Disk space currently used by the account, in bytes (server-set).

block.description: Manages an individual Stalwart account (the `Account` JMAP object with `@type` `User`).

account_key.description: ACME account private key (server-set after registration).

challenge_type.description: ACME challenge method: `TlsAlpn01`, `DnsPersist01`, `Dns01`, or `Http01`. Changing it replaces the ACME provider.

contact.description: Contact email addresses registered with the ACME CA, e.g. `["mailto:admin@example.com"]`.

directory.description: URL of the ACME CA directory endpoint, e.g. `https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory`. Changing it replaces the ACME provider.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the ACME provider.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of ACME challenge retries before giving up.

renew_before.description: Fraction of the certificate lifetime remaining when renewal is triggered: `R12` (1/2), `R23` (2/3), `R34` (3/4), or `R45` (4/5).

block.description: Manages a Stalwart ACME provider for automatic TLS certificate issuance (the `AcmeProvider` JMAP object).

attr_description.description: LDAP attribute(s) containing a human-readable account description.

attr_member_of.description: LDAP attribute(s) listing group memberships (`attrMemberOf` on the wire).

attr_secret.description: LDAP attribute(s) containing the account password hash.

base_dn.description: Base distinguished name for LDAP searches, e.g. `dc=example,dc=com`. Required for `Ldap` type.

bind_dn.description: Distinguished name used to bind to the LDAP server for lookups.

bind_secret.description: Password for the LDAP bind DN. Write-only: the server never returns it, so out-of-band changes are not detected.

claim_username.description: OIDC claim that contains the username, e.g. `preferred_username`.

description.description: Human-readable description of the directory. Required and must be non-empty.

filter_login.description: LDAP filter template for login lookups, e.g. `(&(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)(uid=?))`.

filter_mailbox.description: LDAP filter template for mailbox lookups, e.g. `(&(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)(mail=?))`.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the directory.

issuer_url.description: OIDC issuer URL, e.g. `https://auth.example.com`. Required for `Oidc` type.

type.description: Directory backend type: `Ldap` or `Oidc`. Changing the type replaces the directory.

url.description: LDAP server URL, e.g. `ldap://auth.example.com:389`. Required for `Ldap` type.

block.description: Manages a Stalwart authentication directory backend (the `Directory` JMAP object). Supports LDAP (`Ldap`) and OIDC (`Oidc`) directory types.

algorithm.description: Signing algorithm: `ed25519-sha256` or `rsa-sha256`. Changing the algorithm replaces the signature.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the DKIM signature.

domain.description: Name of the domain this object belongs to, e.g. `example.com`. Resolved to a domain id at apply time. Mutually exclusive with `domain_id`.

domain_id.description: Opaque id of the domain this object belongs to. Mutually exclusive with `domain`.

expiry.description: Duration after which this signature expires (e.g. `90d`), mapping to the `expire` field.

headers.description: Message headers to include in the DKIM signature. Defaults to a standard set.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the DKIM signature.

private_key.description: PEM-encoded private key used to sign outgoing messages.

public_key.description: PEM-encoded public key derived from the private key (server-set).

report.description: Whether to request failure reports. Defaults to `true`.

selector.description: Selector used to locate the DKIM public key in DNS.

block.description: Manages a DKIM signing key for a domain (the `DkimSignature` JMAP object).

description.description: Human-readable description of the DNS server. Required and must be non-empty.

host.description: IP address of the authoritative DNS server. Required for `Tsig` type.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the DNS server.

key.description: Base64-encoded TSIG shared secret. Required for `Tsig` type. Write-only: the server never returns it, so out-of-band changes are not detected.

key_name.description: TSIG key name, e.g. `tsig-key.`. Required for `Tsig` type.

polling_interval.description: Interval between DNS propagation checks (e.g. `10s`). Uses Stalwart duration syntax.

port.description: Port of the authoritative DNS server (default 53). Used by `Tsig` type.

propagation_delay.description: Initial delay before checking DNS propagation (e.g. `5s`). Uses Stalwart duration syntax.

propagation_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for DNS propagation (e.g. `2m`). Uses Stalwart duration syntax.

protocol.description: Transport protocol for TSIG DNS updates: `udp` or `tcp` (default `udp`).

secret.description: API token or key used to authenticate with the DNS provider. Used by cloud providers (Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, etc.). Write-only: the server never returns it, so out-of-band changes are not detected.

timeout.description: Request timeout for DNS API calls (e.g. `30s`, `1m`). Uses Stalwart duration syntax.

tsig_algorithm.description: TSIG HMAC algorithm, e.g. `hmac-sha256`, `hmac-sha512` (default `hmac-md5`). Used by `Tsig` type.

ttl.description: TTL to set on managed DNS records (e.g. `300s`, `5m`). Uses Stalwart duration syntax.

type.description: DNS provider type, e.g. `Cloudflare`, `Tsig`, `DigitalOcean`. Changing the type replaces the DNS server.

block.description: Manages a Stalwart DNS server used for automatic DNS record management (the `DnsServer` JMAP object). Supports cloud providers (Cloudflare, DigitalOcean, etc.) via the `secret` field, and RFC 2136 TSIG via the `host`, `port`, `key_name`, `key`, `protocol`, and `tsig_algorithm` fields.

acme_provider_id.description: ACME provider id used when `certificate_management` is `Automatic`.

aliases.description: Additional domain names that are aliases of this domain. Defaults to an empty list.

allow_relaying.description: Whether to allow relaying for non-local recipients. Defaults to `false`.

catchall.description: Catch-all email address that receives messages addressed to unknown local recipients (maps to the `catchAllAddress` field).

certificate_management.description: TLS certificate management mode: `Manual` or `Automatic`. Defaults to `Manual`.

directory_id.description: Opaque id of the authentication directory used to resolve accounts in this domain. When omitted the server uses the global directory.

dkim_management.description: DKIM key management mode: `Automatic` or `Manual`. Defaults to `Automatic`.

dns_management.description: DNS record management mode: `Manual` or `Automatic`. Defaults to `Manual`.

dns_origin.description: DNS origin (zone root) used when `dns_management` is `Automatic`.

dns_server_id.description: DNS server id used when `dns_management` is `Automatic`.

dns_zone_file.description: Current DNS zone data the server expects to be published for the domain.

enabled.description: Whether this domain is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the domain.

publish_records.description: Set of DNS record types the server should automatically publish when `dns_management` is `Automatic`. Valid values: `dkim`, `tlsa`, `spf`, `mx`, `dmarc`, `srv`, `mtaSts`, `tlsRpt`, `caa`, `autoConfig`, `autoConfigLegacy`, `autoDiscover`.

report_address.description: Address to receive DMARC, TLS-RPT and CAA reports for this domain (maps to `reportAddressUri`). Defaults to `mailto:postmaster`.

subaddressing.description: Sub-addressing (plus addressing) mode: `Enabled` or `Disabled`. Defaults to `Enabled`.

subject_alternative_names.description: Additional subject alternative names (SANs) to include in the TLS certificate when `certificate_management` is `Automatic`.

block.description: Manages a Stalwart email domain (the `Domain` JMAP object).

domain.description: Name of the domain this object belongs to, e.g. `example.com`. Resolved to a domain id at apply time. Mutually exclusive with `domain_id`.

domain_id.description: Opaque id of the domain this object belongs to. Mutually exclusive with `domain`.

email_address.description: Full email address of the group, formed as `name@domain` (server-set).

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the group.

name.description: Group name — the local part of the email address. Changing it replaces the group.

quota.description: Maximum disk space allocated to the group, in bytes (maps to `maxDiskQuota`).

role.description: Built-in role for the group: `Default` or `Custom`. Defaults to `Default`.

role_ids.description: Custom role ids assigned to the group, used when `role` is `Custom`.

used_disk_quota.description: Disk space currently used by the group, in bytes (server-set).

block.description: Manages a Stalwart group (the `Account` JMAP object with `@type` `Group`). Group membership is managed from the member side, via the `member_of` attribute on `stalwart_account`, mirroring the underlying API.

description.description: Human-readable description of the mailing list.

domain.description: Name of the domain this object belongs to, e.g. `example.com`. Resolved to a domain id at apply time. Mutually exclusive with `domain_id`.

domain_id.description: Opaque id of the domain this object belongs to. Mutually exclusive with `domain`.

email_address.description: Full email address of the mailing list, formed as `name@domain` (server-set).

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the mailing list.

name.description: Mailing list name — the local part of the email address. Changing it replaces the mailing list.

recipients.description: Email addresses that are members of the mailing list.

block.description: Manages a Stalwart mailing list (the `MailingList` JMAP object).

bind.description: Set of `host:port` addresses the listener binds to, e.g. `["0.0.0.0:25"]`.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the listener.

name.description: Unique name for this listener, e.g. `smtp`, `smtps`, `imaps`. Changing the name replaces the listener.

override_proxy_trusted_networks.description: CIDR blocks trusted to send proxy-protocol headers for this listener, e.g. `["10.10.10.0/24"]`. Overrides the global proxy trusted network list.

protocol.description: Protocol handled by this listener: `smtp`, `lmtp`, `imap`, `pop3`, `http`, or `manageSieve`.

tls_implicit.description: Whether TLS is negotiated immediately on connection (implicit TLS / SMTPS/IMAPS). Set to `true` for port 465 (SMTPS) and port 993 (IMAPS). Defaults to `false`.

block.description: Manages a Stalwart network listener (the `NetworkListener` JMAP object). A listener binds to one or more addresses and handles a specific mail or HTTP protocol.

description.description: Description of the role. This is the role's human-facing identifier.

disabled_permissions.description: Permissions explicitly disabled by this role; takes precedence over enabled permissions.

enabled_permissions.description: Permissions explicitly enabled by this role.

extends.description: Ids of roles this role extends (maps to `roleIds`).

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the role.

block.description: Manages a Stalwart role: a named set of permissions (the `Role` JMAP object).

domain_id.description: Id of the domain the account belongs to.

email.description: Email address of the account to look up, e.g. `alice@example.com`.

email_address.description: Full email address of the account.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the account.

member_of.description: Ids of groups this account is a member of.

name.description: Account name (the local part of the email address).

quota.description: Maximum disk space allocated, in bytes (the `maxDiskQuota` storage quota).

used_disk_quota.description: Disk space currently used, in bytes.

block.description: Reads a Stalwart account (user or group) by its email address.

domain.description: Fully-qualified domain name to retrieve DNS records for, e.g. `example.com`.

domain_id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the domain.

zone_file.description: DNS zone data the server expects to be published for the domain.

block.description: Reads the DNS record recommendations for a domain. Stalwart exposes the expected records as the read-only `dnsZoneFile` field on the Domain object; this data source returns that zone data so it can be published to an external DNS provider.

catchall.description: Catch-all email address for the domain.

directory_id.description: Opaque id of the authentication directory used for this domain (if any).

dns_zone_file.description: Current DNS zone data the server expects to be published for the domain.

id.description: Opaque server-assigned identifier of the domain.

name.description: Fully-qualified domain name to look up, e.g. `example.com`.

block.description: Reads a Stalwart domain by name.
